title: Petto
tagline: Petto : Travel without having to worry about your pets!
description:
Leaving your pets behind when you go for a little trip can be stressful, and we may even consider cancelling our plans. Petto is here to solve this problem by allowing you to leave your pets with some of the top hosts in your area while you relax and enjoy your trip! Pets can be anyone, a Dog, cat, as well as plants.
Environmental Impact: Helps environment by taking care of plants and animals.
Social Impact: Pet lovers can connect to people in help.
Economical Impact: Gives part-time employment to pet lovers to do the work they always loved to do.
